blocks.t: **Objetivo de comunicação (C1):** eu consigo ler, ouvir, falar e escrever sobre uma pesquisa que quase fracassou, usando follow through on e estruturas enfáticas.

body: Esta aula treina **escrever frases claras e corretas (IELTS Writing, TOEFL Writing)**.

blocks.t: Toque em 🔊, ouça e repita cada palavra. Depois tente adivinhar o sentido.

blocks.title: Story: The Last Interview
paras: Priya had done all the work, but the project **was** on the verge of collapse. **So** exhausted **was** she **that** she nearly canceled the final interview. “**I do want** to finish this,” she told herself. **What she needed was** one more voice.
She **followed through on** her promise to the participants. **Not until** the tape recorder started **did** she relax. **It was** that interview **that** changed the whole study.

items.q: Priya nearly canceled the final interview.
She broke her promise to the participants.
The last interview changed the study.

blocks.body: **follow through on** = cumprir até o fim (promessa, plano). Sinônimos: **carry out, see through**.

items.s: Not until the tape started ___ she relax. (did)

body: **Against all odds.** — Contra todas as probabilidades.
**Keep going.** — Continuar.
**See it through.** — Levar até o fim.
**Stick to one’s guns.** — Manter-se firme.
**Light at the end of the tunnel.** — Luz no fim do túnel.
**Hang in there.** — Aguentar firme.
**Dig deep.** — Buscar forças.
**The final stretch.** — A reta final.
**Why did Priya nearly cancel the interview?** — Por que a Priya quase cancelou a entrevista?
**Did she follow through on her promise?** — Ela cumpriu a promessa?
**Yes, and that interview changed the study.** — Sim, e aquela entrevista mudou o estudo.

blocks.title: Pronúncia: Organização da informação pela entonação

items.label: Organização da informação pela entonação
items.note: A entonação organiza o discurso: queda = informação completa; subida = há mais por vir; a informação nova recebe o foco (nuclear stress).

prompts.model: I will follow through on my plan.
So tired was he that he slept.

blocks.task: Write a 7-sentence story paragraph using follow through on, emphatic do, so… that and a cleft.
blocks.model: Priya had done all the work, but the project was on the verge of collapse. So exhausted was she that she nearly canceled the final interview. “I do want to finish this,” she told herself. She followed through on her promise to the participants. Not until the tape recorder started did she relax. It was that interview that changed the whole study. She never regretted it.

body: Treine esta habilidade com o formato de tarefas curtas das provas (TOEFL/IELTS).
Leia o enunciado primeiro e procure as palavras-chave.
Use exemplos reais da vida dos alunos e peça frases próprias.
Corrija o erro mais frequente da aula em grupo, sem expor o aluno.
Retome o conteúdo na aula seguinte com um exercício curto.
